_comment: Curated breadth grid for the home page. The featured deck is identified by featured: true (positional order is not load-bearing — the implementer should select by flag, not by index). Featured deck plays inline on click; remaining decks link through to detail pages. See HOMEPAGE-IMPLEMENTATION-PROMPT.md §5.2 and §6.3. Operator-managed via git; no DB query at home-page render. File belongs at frontend/config/homepage-featured-decks.json. Thumbnail and deck URLs follow the canonical nginx serving pattern from CLAUDE.md §15.7: https://lessoncraftstudio.com/<locale>/decks/<slug>/. The topic field supports the no-two-thumbnails-on-same-topic invariant from HOMEPAGE-SAVE-STATE.md Section 2.

decks.title: Picture Sudoku
decks._note: Featured tile — plays inline on click. Picked per Section-2 curation v1 doc: visually rich and broadly familiar; image-sudoku rendering is immediately legible as 'this is a real K-3 worksheet'; demonstrates inline-play affordance well.

_known_state_notes: Deck titles are operator-authored at app-side and stored verbatim per row in the DB. Locale heterogeneity is observable across Tier 1 (DE rows mix DE-native titles like 'Additionsspaß' / 'Wörter suchen' with English-language titles like 'More or Less Practice') and now extends to Tier 2 (es rows currently carry English-language titles like 'Grid Match' / 'Picture Sort' per operator authoring at first-publish time). Titles above mirror DB state verbatim; do NOT auto-translate or normalize. Per CLAUDE.md §17.5 Tier 1 EN+DE discipline + Tier 2 follow-on, operator may revise specific titles in a future content-authoring pass.
_growth_plan: Section-2 curation v1 + Track C Batch 1 stagger: 8 picks across en + de + es = 3 + 3 + 2 (Tier 2 first-row event applied Option D stagger per recon: dropped math-puzzle-en + matching-letter-de; added grid-match-es + picture-sort-es). Themed/themeless equilibrium preserved at 4/4. featured: true unchanged on sudoku-en. When nl lands at Tier 2 Track C Batch N, swap further per Option D semantics. Tier 3+ (sv, fi, no, fr, it, da, pt) shifts when those launch.
